units.brief:

Task. Build the measurement harness and capture the baseline from the current code (commit 29c5c08). Nothing in the engine changes.

1. Root Cargo.toml: [profile.release] lto = "fat", codegen-units = 1, keep debug = 1. Add `out/` to .gitignore.
2. New crate crates/soundgate (binary `soundgate`, deps: hound, serde, serde_json, clap). It must not depend on any engine crate; it carries its own radix-2 f64 FFT. Subcommands:
   - `ltas <dir>`: for each *.wav in dir (mono or stereo; sum channel powers), 1/3-octave long-term spectrum over the 28 IEC 61260 centres 25 Hz-16 kHz, computed from Hann-windowed 8192-point frames with 50% overlap, averaged only over active 2048-sample blocks (blocks whose RMS exceeds 5% of the loudest block, the rule of dsp::mix::active_rms); each band in dB relative to the file's total active power. Also: gated RMS in dBFS, active-block fraction, sample peak, count of NaN/inf samples. Write <dir>/ltas.json keyed by file stem.
   - `compare <base.json> <new.json> --tol-mid DB --tol-edge DB`: per file present in both, max |delta| over bands 100 Hz-10 kHz and over the rest; active fraction delta (limit 15 points); for `mix` also gated RMS (limit 1.5 dB) and peak 0.89 +- 0.002; any NaN/inf fails; a file present in one side only fails. Print one table row per file, exit 1 on any failure.
   - `pitch <wav> <notes.json>`: notes.json is [{t0,t1,midi}]; for each note of 150 ms or longer, YIN (de Cheveigne and Kawahara 2002, threshold 0.1, 40 ms frames, 10 ms hop) over the middle 60%, median f0; report the fraction within 50 cents of the note and the number of octave errors (within 50 cents of +-12 semitones). Write JSON next to the wav.
   Unit tests: ltas of a synthetic 1 kHz sine puts > 99% of power in the 1 kHz band; pitch finds a 220 Hz sawtooth within 2 cents.
3. crates/engine/examples/stems.rs (current API; compiles only with the engine feature capture_raw: gate it with #[cfg(feature = "capture_raw")] and a main that explains the feature otherwise). Args --seed S --out DIR. Normalize engine::demo_song() with compose::song::normalize_song, call engine::render_song_threaded(song, seed, None, &Tuning::default()), time it. For each raw track in RenderedSong::raw_tracks apply the channel strip exactly as dsp::mix::compute_track does, using its public pieces (dsp::mix::eq_for, dsp::filter::bq/run_bq, dsp::mix::active_rms, level 0.1/rms, dsp::dynamics::compress for lead and harmony with threshold db_of(0.1)+1, ratio 3, 0.008, 0.15, knee 6); skip silent tracks; write each as 32-bit float WAV named lead, doubles, harmony, choir, guitar, harmony_guitar, bass, drums, harp, violin (write the WAV header by hand; engine has no hound). Then call engine::mix_threaded on the rendered song with every track enabled and write mix.wav. Write notes.json with the lead vocal notes (t0, t1, midi after transposition, from the Prepared data the lead vocal is rendered from; read crates/engine/src/vocals.rs render_lead to find them) and render.json with wall times for render and mix.
4. crates/dsp/examples/helmholtz.rs: the Rust port of tests/sweep2.js against dsp::violin::render_violin: for midi 55..=90, velocity in {0.4, 0.6, 0.85}, seeds {1, 2}: one note t0 0.1 s, t1 1.2 s, length 1.6 s, seed m*13+sd*101+round(v*10); Goertzel magnitudes over samples 0.45 s..1.0 s at f, 2f, f/2, 1.5f; stable if a1 > 0.35*a2 and a(f/2) < 0.1*a1 and a(1.5f) < 0.1*a1. Print `stable N/216` and the failing notes.
5. scripts/gate.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail), usage `scripts/gate.sh [--strict] [--against DIR] [--capture-baseline] LABEL`. Exactly the steps in docs/engine-design.md section 12 and the sound_gate definition: builds; stems for seeds 1234 and 2718 into out/gate/LABEL/sS (pass --features capture_raw only if crates/engine/Cargo.toml still declares that feature); soundgate ltas and pitch; vow example; helmholtz (instruments example if crates/instruments/examples/helmholtz.rs exists, else the dsp one); /usr/bin/time -v on `target/release/sunflower demo --seed 1234 -o out/gate/LABEL/demo.wav` threaded and with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 (add --sequential if `sunflower demo --help` lists it); sha256 of both WAVs; tolerances 0.5/1.0 dB with --strict else 3/6 dB; --against compares LTAS and pitch with another run's directory instead of tests/soundgate/baseline; --capture-baseline copies the JSON results into tests/soundgate/baseline/sS/ and writes tests/soundgate/baseline/{vow.txt,helmholtz.txt}. Append a row to tests/soundgate/perf.tsv: label, git short hash, threaded wall s, threaded max RSS MB, one-thread wall s, one-thread max RSS MB, sha-equal yes/no. Print a PASS/FAIL table and exit 1 on failure. Perf regression check: compare with the previous perf.tsv row (10% limit).
6. Capture the baseline: `scripts/gate.sh --capture-baseline base-29c5c08`. Commit tests/soundgate/ (JSON, TSV, txt only; no audio). Then run `scripts/gate.sh --strict base-check` and confirm every line passes against itself.

Report the baseline numbers: per-stem active fractions, lead pitch fraction, vowel distance, helmholtz count, and the four perf numbers.

Task. Fill the four empty sfcore modules and wire denormal flushing. Do not touch js.rs, rng.rs, tuning.rs, v8math.rs (deleted in wave 5).
1. math.rs: clamp, lerp, smoothstep(e0, e1, x), mtof(m: f64) = 440 * exp2((m - 69)/12), db_to_gain, gain_to_db (floor at -200 dB), one_pole_coeff_hz(fc, fs) = 1 - exp(-2 pi fc / fs), one_pole_coeff_tau(tau, fs) = 1 - exp(-1/(tau fs)), fold_octave(m, lo, hi). Doc each.
2. fp.rs: `pub fn flush_denormals()` sets FTZ and DAZ on the current thread (x86_64: MXCSR |= 0x8040 via std::arch::x86_64::{_mm_getcsr,_mm_setcsr} with #[allow(deprecated)]; aarch64: set FPCR bit 24 (FZ) with inline asm; other targets: no-op). `pub fn init_pool(threads: Option<usize>)` builds the rayon global pool with start_handler calling flush_denormals (ignore the error if a pool exists already). sfcore needs rayon as a dependency: you may add `rayon = "1.10"` to crates/core/Cargo.toml (this one line is allowed). Unit test: after flush_denormals, 1e-310_f64 * 1.0 read through a black_box is 0 on x86_64.
3. random.rs: `pub struct Rng` = xoshiro128++ (Blackman and Vigna 2018), seeded from a u64 through SplitMix64 (Steele, Lea, Flood 2014). `pub struct Tag(pub u64)`, `pub const fn tag(name: &str) -> Tag` (FNV-1a 64 over bytes, const loop). `Rng::stream(seed: u64, tag: Tag)`, `Rng::event(seed: u64, tag: Tag, index: u64)` (mix seed, tag and index through SplitMix64). Methods next_u32, uniform() in [0,1) from 53 bits (two draws) or 32 bits (document which; 32 bits is enough for audio), bipolar() in [-1,1), gauss() by the Marsaglia polar method with the second deviate cached, fill_bipolar(&mut [f32]), below(n) (unbiased), pick(&[T]). Tests: mean and variance of uniform and gauss over 1e6 draws within 1%; streams with different tags or indices are uncorrelated (|r| < 0.01); same inputs give the same sequence.
4. time.rs: `pub fn sample_at(t: f64) -> isize = (t * SR as f64).round() as isize`; `pub fn len_samples(t_end: f64) -> usize = (t_end * SR).ceil()`.

6. FTZ wiring: in crates/sunflower/src/main.rs call sfcore::fp::init_pool(None) and sfcore::fp::flush_denormals() at the top of main. In crates/engine/src/render.rs call flush_denormals() at the start of render_song_impl and as the first statement in every std::thread::scope spawn closure. Change nothing else in those files.
7. Measure: `scripts/gate.sh --strict w1-sfcore`. The render must be bit-identical in sound terms (FTZ only flushes values below 1e-38) and the one-thread time must drop (expected about 1.5 s on the mix).

units.brief:

Edit only the files you own; if you need a change elsewhere, stop and report it. Never run git switch, checkout, stash, rebase or force-push; never commit to main. Task. Write the delay-based and stochastic primitives the instrument and reverb units will use in wave 2. Nothing is wired yet.
1. delay.rs: `DelayLine { buf: Vec<f32>, mask: usize, w: usize }` with power-of-two capacity (new(max_delay)), push(x), read_int(d), read_linear(d: f64), read_lagrange3(d: f64) (4-point third-order Lagrange; valid for d >= 1), clear. `SchroederAllpass { line: DelayLine, delay: usize, g: f32 }` (Schroeder 1962) with tick. `Thiran1 { c: f64, x1: f64, y1: f64 }` first-order Thiran allpass for fractional delay delta in [0.5, 1.5): c = (1 - delta)/(1 + delta) (Thiran 1971; Laakso et al. 1996), set_delay(delta), tick; also `phase_delay(w)` for tests. `fn one_pole_phase_delay(a, w) -> f64` helper for loop tuning (document the formula used in crates/dsp/src/pluck.rs; read it).
2. stochastic.rs: `RandomWalk { v, w, leak, step, limit }` = the leaky second-order random walk used in voice synth (formant wobble), voice controls (pitch drift) and violin (wander): read crates/voice/src/synth.rs, crates/voice/src/controls.rs and crates/dsp/src/violin.rs, write one struct that reproduces all three uses (v += step * noise; v *= leak; w = clamp(w + v * k, -limit, limit)); `OuProcess { x, mu, theta, sigma }` Ornstein-Uhlenbeck with exact discretisation x = mu + (x - mu) e^{-theta dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 theta dt})/(2 theta)) N(0,1) (document; compare with the closure in violin.rs and note any difference). Both take `&mut sfcore::random::Rng` if it exists; if the sfcore unit has not landed yet, take a `FnMut() -> f64` noise source instead and say so.

units.brief:

2. crates/soundgate/src/mean.rs:153: the allowance max(fixed, 2*sd) is too loose on stems whose takes are bimodal (up to 19 dB on harmony). Cap the allowance (for example at 6 dB in 100 Hz-10 kHz and 9 dB elsewhere) or use a robust spread (median absolute deviation), and justify the choice with the numbers from the current baseline-mean.
3. crates/soundgate/src/mean.rs:38: the mix gated-RMS limit is 2 dB; section 12 says 1.5 dB. Use 1.5 dB unless the measured seed spread shows it cannot hold; say which.
